name: riptide-rally-app
description: Riptide Rally packaged as iPhone and Android apps with Capacitor

scripts.android: node prepare-web.mjs && npx cap add android; node patch-native.mjs android && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: node prepare-web.mjs && npx cap add ios; node patch-native.mjs ios && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
